newsitem.title: USA: Litton unit wins contracts worth $300 mln.
newsitem.headline: Litton unit wins contracts worth $300 mln.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc Monday said unit PRC, an information technology provider, has won two contracts valued at a total of $300 million.

The first, a 10-year deal worth $100 million, was awarded by the U.S. Army Communications and Electronics Command. It calls for PRC to support the modernization of network switch systems for the Army and other defense-related agencies.

The second, a five-year deal worth $200 million, comes from Defense Supply Services-Washington, and calls for PRC to provide services to the Office of the Secretary of Defense for Command, Control, Communications and Intelligence.
